title: Gator Swamp
text:
You've ended up in the Gator swamp. The goal is simple:

- Navigate past the gators without falling in (DM decides how
- Make it to the bottom left of the map to get to the docks!
dmNotes:
# Who's in this scene

- the party
- the gators

## What you need to do

- If the party chose the poisonous bramble path, move the party to the bottom right of the map, which means they need to cross less bridges
- If the party chose the northern forest path, they can stay where they spawn in and they will need to cross four bridges

Each party member needs to make a check to cross each bridge. You can either have them

- Require the party to get an average roll of over 10 on each bridge to cross
- Or instead, require everyone in the party to roll higher than a 2

If either condition is not met, the swamp gators attack the party.
